**Big. `account_id` appears 1082 times in 94 files.** Most is safe. Four zones are not.

| Zone | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | Public field. Breaks every client. |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js#L8) | 1 | `WIRE` right side is the wire name. |
| [migrations/](migrations/) | 37 | Already applied. Editing rewrites history. |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk/](vendor/reporting-sdk/) | 12 | Regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh`. |

Also frozen: the SQL column in repo query strings. That is 250 lines. The DB column stays until its own migration.

Sign off only if the plan renames JS identifiers alone.
